match_name: Gujarat Titans v Rajasthan Royals at New Chandigarh, Tata Indian Premier League, 29 May 2026
ground_name: PCA International Cricket Stadium, Ground A, New Chandigarh

commentary: A full delivery drifting wide outside off comes in to Rahul Tewatia, who drives it crisply through extra cover. The shot is well timed and controlled, racing away to the boundary. Rahul Tewatia adds another four, his second boundary of this over.
match_name: Gujarat Titans v Rajasthan Royals at New Chandigarh, Tata Indian Premier League, 29 May 2026
ground_name: PCA International Cricket Stadium, Ground A, New Chandigarh

commentary: A half-tracker drifting outside off stump, left alone carefully by Rahul Tewatia, allowing it to pass safely to the keeper for no run.
match_name: Gujarat Titans v Rajasthan Royals at New Chandigarh, Tata Indian Premier League, 29 May 2026
ground_name: PCA International Cricket Stadium, Ground A, New Chandigarh

commentary: A length ball outside off comes without movement, and Rahul Tewatia lashes a middled, controlled slog over long on for six! That's three boundaries in this over. Gujarat Titans have reached the target, winning by seven wickets!
match_name: Gujarat Titans v Rajasthan Royals at New Chandigarh, Tata Indian Premier League, 29 May 2026
